correctness.rationale: Canonical coherent orientation of all 2^d facets yields d!vol=|det C|. Orthogonal Procrustes yields D=4d-2sum(s_i). AM-GM yields the exact envelope. Equality iff C is scalar orthogonal. The cyclic rational-sphere construction yields C=2rI, with all supporting facets certified for t/r<1/2 and the origin interior. Exact Fraction verification checks 15 configurations across dimensions 2..6, but the proof covers all d>=2.

value.rationale: The main object is the class underlying the recently resolved eight-vertex spherical volume problem. The theorem determines an optimal continuous deficit-versus-distance curve throughout an explicit nontrivial interval, equality classes and the exact infinitesimal coefficient in all dimensions. It distinguishes noncentral symmetry of extremizing perturbations from orthogonality of their pair difference vectors.
